name: hero-language-camp
description: Open-source gamified learning prototype for low-resource and community languages.

scripts.validate:content: npm run test:yaml-parser && node tools/validate-content.mjs content-packs/hy-eastern-it
scripts.check: npm run validate:content && npm run content:audit-curriculum-v2 && npm run content:lint-italian && npm run typecheck
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.assets:generate-parallax: python tools/generate-parallax-assets.py && python tools/generate-guide-assets.py && python tools/import-hero-animation-sheets.py && python tools/import-companion-animation-sheets.py && npm run assets:sync
scripts.assets:generate-realistic: python tools/generate-realistic-assets.py && python tools/generate-guide-assets.py && python tools/import-hero-animation-sheets.py && python tools/import-companion-animation-sheets.py && npm run assets:sync
scripts.assets:generate-guides: python tools/generate-guide-assets.py && python tools/import-hero-animation-sheets.py && python tools/import-companion-animation-sheets.py && npm run assets:sync
scripts.assets:generate-labyrinth-placeholders: python tools/generate-labyrinth-placeholder-assets.py && python tools/generate-low-labyrinth-walls.py && npm run assets:sync
scripts.assets:extract-labyrinth-ai: python tools/extract-labyrinth-ai-atlas.py asset-packs/cc0-pixel-v10/sources/labyrinth-ai-v0115/labyrinth-ai-atlas.png asset-packs/cc0-pixel-v10/labyrinth --preview asset-packs/cc0-pixel-v10/sources/labyrinth-ai-v0115/labyrinth-ai-assets-preview.png && python tools/generate-low-labyrinth-walls.py && npm run assets:sync
scripts.check:danish: npm run validate:danish && npm run validate:danish:curriculum && npm --workspace @hero-lang/foundations-engine run typecheck && npm --workspace @hero-lang/danish-foundations run typecheck
scripts.verify:local: npm run check && npm run check:english && npm run check:danish && npm run build:site
scripts.check:english: npm run content:check-english-sync && npm run content:audit-english && npm --workspace @hero-lang/web run typecheck
